nodes.summary: The entire exponential integral $\operatorname{Ein}$ is complex analytic at every point of $\mathbb{C}$.
nodes.title: Analyticity of the entire exponential integral

nodes.summary: The entire exponential integral $\operatorname{Ein}$ is complex differentiable at every point of $\mathbb{C}$.
nodes.title: Differentiability of the entire exponential integral

nodes.summary: For every $n \in \mathbb{N}$, the totalized sum of the first $n$ terms of the asymptotic expansion of $E_1$ equals $0$ at $z = 0$.
nodes.title: Totalized partial sums of the $E_1$ expansion vanish at zero

nodes.summary: For $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and every complex number $z$, this is $\sum_{j < n} t_j(z)$, where $t_j(z) = \frac{e^{-z}}{z} \cdot \frac{(-1)^j \, j!}{z^j}$ with division by zero read as $0$.
nodes.title: Totalized partial sum of the $E_1$ asymptotic expansion

nodes.summary: For $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and a nonzero complex number $z$, the sum of the first $n$ terms of the asymptotic expansion of the exponential integral $E_1$ is $\sum_{j < n} \frac{e^{-z}}{z} \cdot \frac{(-1)^j \, j!}{z^j}$.
nodes.title: Partial sum of the $E_1$ asymptotic expansion

nodes.summary: For every $n \in \mathbb{N}$, the totalized remainder of the asymptotic expansion of $E_1$ after $n$ terms equals $-\gamma$ at $z = 0$, where $\gamma$ is the Euler–Mascheroni constant.
nodes.title: Totalized $E_1$ remainder at zero

nodes.summary: For $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and every complex number $z$, this is $\operatorname{Ein}(z) - \operatorname{Log} z - \gamma - S_n(z)$, where $\operatorname{Ein}$ is the entire exponential integral, $\operatorname{Log}$ is the principal logarithm extended by $\operatorname{Log} 0 = 0$, $\gamma$ is the Euler–Mascheroni constant and $S_n$ is the totalized sum of the first $n$ terms of the asymptotic expansion of $E_1$.
nodes.title: Totalized remainder of the $E_1$ asymptotic expansion

nodes.summary: For $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and a nonzero complex number $z$, the remainder after $n$ terms is $E_1(z) - \sum_{j < n} \frac{e^{-z}}{z} \cdot \frac{(-1)^j \, j!}{z^j}$, where $E_1$ is the principal exponential integral.
nodes.title: Remainder of the $E_1$ asymptotic expansion

nodes.summary: For every $n \in \mathbb{N}$, the totalized $n$-th term $\frac{e^{-z}}{z} \cdot \frac{(-1)^n \, n!}{z^n}$ of the asymptotic expansion of $E_1$, with division by zero read as $0$, equals $0$ at $z = 0$.
nodes.title: Totalized $E_1$ asymptotic terms vanish at zero

nodes.summary: For $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and every complex number $z$, the $n$-th term of the asymptotic expansion of $E_1$ is $\frac{e^{-z}}{z} \cdot \frac{(-1)^n \, n!}{z^n}$, with division by zero read as $0$.
nodes.title: Totalized asymptotic term of $E_1$

nodes.summary: For $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and a nonzero complex number $z$, the $n$-th term of the asymptotic expansion of the exponential integral $E_1$ is $\frac{e^{-z}}{z} \cdot \frac{(-1)^n \, n!}{z^n}$.
nodes.title: Asymptotic term of $E_1$

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$ and a complex number $z$, this is the complex number $\frac{(-1)^n z^{n+1}}{(n+1) \cdot (n+1)!}$, the term of index $j = n + 1$ in the series $\operatorname{Ein}(z) = \sum_{j \ge 1} \frac{(-1)^{j+1} z^j}{j \cdot j!}$.
nodes.title: Terms of the series for the entire exponential integral

nodes.summary: The entire exponential integral is the function $\operatorname{Ein} : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ defined by $\operatorname{Ein}(z) = \sum_{j \ge 1} \frac{(-1)^{j+1} z^j}{j \cdot j!}$.
nodes.title: The entire exponential integral Ein

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the function $t \mapsto e^{-t} t^n$ is Lebesgue integrable on the open interval $(0, \infty)$.
nodes.title: Integrability of $e^{-t} t^n$ on $(0, \infty)$

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the integral of $e^{-t} t^n$ over the open interval $(0, \infty)$ equals $n!$.
nodes.title: The moments of $e^{-t}$ are factorials

nodes.title: Outer-sector bound for the quadratic integral remainder

nodes.summary: For every complex number $z$, the entire exponential integral $\operatorname{Ein}$ satisfies $z \operatorname{Ein}'(z) = 1 - e^{-z}$.
nodes.title: Derivative of the entire exponential integral

nodes.summary: Let $z \ne 0$ be a complex number with $\pi/2 \le |\arg z| < \pi$, where $\arg z \in (-\pi, \pi]$ is the principal argument, and let $t \ge 0$ be a real number. Then $|z| \sin |\arg z| \le |t + z|$.
nodes.title: Lower bound for $|t + z|$ in the outer sector

nodes.summary: Let $z \ne 0$ be a complex number with $\pi/2 \le |\arg z| < \pi$, where $\arg z \in (-\pi, \pi]$ is the principal argument. Then $\sin |\arg z| > 0$.
nodes.title: Positivity of $\sin |\arg z|$ in the outer sector

nodes.summary: The totalized kernel $\operatorname{Ein}(z) - \operatorname{Log} z - \gamma$, where $\operatorname{Ein}$ is the entire exponential integral, $\operatorname{Log}$ is the principal logarithm extended by $\operatorname{Log} 0 = 0$ and $\gamma$ is the Euler–Mascheroni constant, equals $-\gamma$ at $z = 0$.
nodes.title: Totalized principal $E_1$ kernel at zero

nodes.summary: For every complex number $z$, this is $\operatorname{Ein}(z) - \operatorname{Log} z - \gamma$, where $\operatorname{Ein}(z) = \sum_{j \ge 1} (-1)^{j+1} z^j / (j \cdot j!)$ is the entire exponential integral, $\operatorname{Log}$ is the principal branch of the complex logarithm (imaginary part in $(-\pi, \pi]$) extended by $\operatorname{Log} 0 = 0$, and $\gamma$ is the Euler–Mascheroni constant.
nodes.title: Totalized principal exponential integral

nodes.summary: Let $z \ne 0$ be a complex number with $\pi/2 \le |\arg z| < \pi$, where $\arg z \in (-\pi, \pi]$ is the principal argument. Let $E_1(z)$ be the principal exponential integral, let $T_n(z) = \frac{e^{-z}}{z} \cdot \frac{(-1)^n n!}{z^n}$ be the $n$-th term of its asymptotic expansion, and let $R_2(z) = E_1(z) - T_0(z) - T_1(z)$ be the remainder after the first two terms. Then…
nodes.title: Two-term remainder bound for $E_1$ in the outer sector

nodes.summary: For a nonzero complex number $z$, the principal exponential integral is $E_1(z) = \operatorname{Ein}(z) - \operatorname{Log} z - \gamma$, where $\operatorname{Ein}(z) = \sum_{j \ge 1} (-1)^{j+1} z^j / (j \cdot j!)$ is the entire exponential integral, $\operatorname{Log}$ is the principal branch of the complex logarithm (imaginary part in $(-\pi, \pi]$) and $\gamma$ is the Euler–Mascheroni constant.
nodes.title: The principal exponential integral

nodes.summary: Let $z \ne 0$ be a complex number and $t$ a real number with $t + z \ne 0$. Then $\frac{1}{t + z} = \frac{1}{z} - \frac{t}{z^2} + \frac{t^2}{z^2 (t + z)}$.
nodes.title: Two-term expansion of $1/(t + z)$

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
